newsitem.title: USA: Health Power unit now off supervisory hold.
newsitem.headline: Health Power unit now off supervisory hold.

text.p: Health Power Inc said Friday its wholly owned health management subsidiary, Health Power HMO Inc, was released from supervision by the Ohio Department of Insurance effective March 20.
It said the department's action followed steps it took to to bring the unit into compliance with Ohio's statutory net worth requirements for health management organizations.
It said the unit has maintained normal business operations since being placed under supervision on December 5.
